description.value: Sanduz Estate Winery is an international award-winning estate winery situated in the heart of Richmond's agricultural lands, producing a range of fruit and grape wines including blueberry, peach, Gewürztraminer, and port-style blends. The winery features both a retail shop and an on-site tasting room where visitors can sample wines made from locally grown fruit and berries. It sits roughly 15 minutes from YVR and makes a distinctive stop on any cycling route through Richmond's farmland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from sanduzwines.com is fully available and confirms an active, open estate winery with a physical store and tasting room at 12791 Blundell Rd, Richmond, BC. The phone number (604-214-0444) and address appear consistently across all website subpages. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the shop sells bottled wine for purchase to take away, which qualifies as takeout.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only; OSM tags should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible estate winery with a retail shop and tasting room; a distinctive stop for touring cyclists in Richmond's farmland.
